policy: Every failed preservation obligation vetoes, without a code whitelist
Composition guard executes in Worker or staged calculation, not through main-thread reparsing
Exact raw source/candidate strings, pre-cleanup serialized options and original task context bind the verdict
No verdict, stale verdict or failed verdict cannot authorize editor writes
Approved source-only spelling and registry-proved DOI projections retain exact raw input binding
Editorial reports are separate from preservation obligations
Actual automatic-result, manual review/spelling and disambiguation consumers check before writing
Preview-isolated refreshed candidates bind their actual preimage
The UI keeps the original source with a compact status; CSS/talk/Undo retain independent explicit proofs
